# mtncloud_docker_clusters (Data Source)

Lists your Docker clusters, including those made in the console. A Docker cluster, built with `mtncloud_docker_cluster` or in the console.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_docker_clusters" "all" {}

output "docker_clusters" {
  value = [for c in data.mtncloud_docker_clusters.all.docker_clusters : c.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Only list Docker clusters whose `cloud` is this (case ignored).
- `group` (String) Only list Docker clusters whose `group` is this (case ignored).
- `labels` (List of String) Only list Docker clusters that have every one of these `labels` (case ignored).
- `layout` (String) Only list Docker clusters whose `layout` is this (case ignored).
- `name_regex` (String) Only return Docker clusters whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.
- `status` (String) Only list Docker clusters whose `status` is this (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `docker_clusters` (Attributes List) The Docker clusters, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--docker_clusters))

<a id="nestedatt--docker_clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `docker_clusters`

Read-Only:

- `api_url` (String) Kubernetes API address, or empty.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud the cluster is in.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `group` (String) Group the cluster belongs to.
- `id` (Number) ID of the Docker cluster.
- `labels` (List of String) Labels.
- `layout` (String) Layout the cluster was built from, for example `MTN Kubernetes HA (3)`.
- `name` (String) Name of the Docker cluster.
- `node_ids` (List of Number) IDs of the cluster's nodes (masters and workers; Docker: hosts).
- `status` (String) Status, for example `ok`.
